newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford to add 175 new jobs to unit.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford to add 175 new jobs to unit.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said it is adding 175 new sales and customer service jobs - or nearly 10 percent more employees -- to its Southington, Conn., personal lines insurance facility by year-end.
The new employees will raise the Southington office employment to 1,965 from 1,790 and boost the company's Hartford County employment to 9,005 from 8,830.

"Over the past ten years, our Southington personal lines facility has grown significantly, in terms of revenue and employment," said Stephen Hasenmiller, senior vice president, personal lines insurance for The Hartford.
"The 175 new employees, who will work predominantly in sales will help us accelerate that trend so we can realize significant sales growth in 1997," he said.
Last year, The Hartford's Southington personal lines facility reported more than $1.1 billion in revenues.

In the first six months of 1996, written premium, or sales, for the Southing personal lines insurance operations was 7 percent higher than during the same period last year and the company is targeting higher growth for 1997.
